items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Somewhere back, I think on our second tape, you mentioned a white singer who sang like Billy Eckstein, but you couldn't remember his last name.

ctx.x: But any way he died about a year ago, and Georgia All came by to tell me because we were all very dear friends. Now, I had to just inject that because I didn't -- I thought it would be of some interest to you. [PAUSE]
